description: This file defines the class 'TDistribution' which implements Student's t-distribution including its probability density, cumulative distribution, and statistical properties such as mean and variance.

classes.name: TDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of Student's t-distribution providing methods for PDF, CDF, mean, variance, and support bounds.

methods.name: getDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function at a given point.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution if defined, otherwise NaN.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution if defined, otherwise NaN or infinity.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution support (always negative infinity).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution support (always positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the lower bound is inclusive (always false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the upper bound is inclusive (always false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates if the support of the distribution is connected (always true).
